question: Which analyses reconstruct a Higgs-boson candidate as a physical object they select on (rather than merely studying Higgs production or decay)?

answer.text:
The analyses that explicitly reconstruct a Higgs boson candidate as a physical object and use it in their selection criteria are arXiv:2103.04956 (four-lepton Higgs candidate), arXiv:2111.08340 (H-jet from \\( H \\to b\\bar{b} \\) decays), and arXiv:2504.13081 (reconstructed Higgs candidate). These papers define the Higgs candidate as a detector object and use it in their selection criteria, as recorded in the graph.
